title: 第612章 生死一瞬间第611章 真武境六重巅峰的实力
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“不对啊？刚才这边明明有打斗能量波动！”
就在蔡冕追着林晨而去后。
袁畅等几人迅速赶来，眉头紧锁。
“下面这些被斩断的大树，弥漫着强烈的剑意。”
袁畅身上灵力运转到极致。
想到这里，脸色顿时大变：“不好，林晨那小子有危险。”
卢珲和尹嵩两人也是一震，确实能够在现场留下这么恐怖的剑意，似乎只有林晨能够做到。
“袁队长，怎么了？”
潘威迅速迎上来，他可是第一次见到袁畅脸色如此难看。
“潘城主，我们大家立刻分开行动，所有人沿着不同的方向飞翔，不断的运转灵力，就给我叫唤林晨的名字，一定要越大声越好，一旦发现下方山林有战斗，立刻释放信号弹。”
根本来不及多想，袁畅很清楚林晨的实力，现场这么多参天大树被剑气洞穿，却好像没有出现多余的战斗痕迹，极有可能就是林晨面对的敌人很强，对方的实力已经远远超过林晨。
“行动！”
袁畅不给众人任何回答的余地，身上的灵力激荡而起，整个人率先凌空而行，就开始朗声吆喝“林晨”。
……
轰！
林晨不断朝着身前逃窜，约莫小半个时辰过去，身后的蔡冕猛然冲上来，双手陡然汇聚，形成无数的灵力气浪。
狂暴的掌印弥漫，一道道天地灵力汇聚，就狠狠朝着林晨轰击过来。
唰！
林晨双眸弥漫着森然的寒光，手中的血夜剑狠狠斩出去，携带着强烈的剑气，无垢十三剑施展到极致。
然而，剑芒与掌印碰撞，仿佛斩在一团棉花之上。

“小子，不要做无谓的挣扎，乖乖束手就擒，兴许我可以饶你一命。”蔡冕盯着数十米开外的林晨，内心也暗暗震惊。
他实在是想不明白，一个元婴境三重巅峰毛头小子，手段层出不穷，刚才他一路追杀而来。
若不是他修为足够强横，感悟的风之意境，速度远远超过其他真武境六重巅峰武者，恐怕还真的要被这个小子逃走了。
嘭！
剑芒撕裂，掌印狠狠砸在林晨的胸膛之上，一口鲜血顿时喷出来，就直接倒飞出去十多米。
“大哥哥！利用太渊神殿砸死他！”
灵魂识海里面，灵儿面色微凝，双眸闪烁着紧张，两只手死死捏成拳头，身上一股雄浑的气势爆发出来，整个人站在太渊神殿的屋檐边上。
“这家伙的实力很强，他也很警惕，几乎没有靠近我，想要这样砸死他太难。”林晨缓缓摇摇头。
他之前动用过一次太渊神殿，很清楚那东西的恐怖，几乎将他全身的灵力抽的干干净净。
以他现在的状态，一旦动用太渊神殿无法震杀对方，恐怕连动用灵魂力量的能力都没有。
“这么强悍的气血，若是我能够将他活捉，慢慢一点点吞噬他的气血，极有可能助我突破真武境七重啊。”
蔡冕双眸死死盯着倒在地上的林晨，内心弥漫着激动之色。
他虽然很忌惮林晨的身份，害怕对方身上隐藏着封家老祖的灵魂力量。
但是，这也是他接连追杀林晨这么长时间，却依旧没有痛下杀手的原因。若是林晨身体里面隐藏有后手，必然已经释放出来了。
“想要我束手就擒，也不是不可以。”
林晨暗暗运转灵力，倚靠在一根大树之上，嘴角鲜血流淌出来，声音故作无比虚弱的道。
“哦？你说说看。”
蔡冕闻言，脸上难得浮现出笑容。
以他真武境六重巅峰的修为，对面的林晨根本没有逃窜的机会，这也是他如此镇定自若的原因。
“你先告诉我你是谁？”
content_en:
"Isn't that right? There was clearly a fighting energy fluctuation here just now!"
Just after Cai Mian chased Lin Chen.
Yuan Chang and others rushed over quickly, their brows furrowed.
"The severed trees below are filled with strong sword intent."
Yuan Chang's spiritual power was operating to the extreme.
Thinking of this, his expression suddenly changed: "No, that boy Lin Chen is in danger."
Lu Hui and Yin Song were also shocked. It seemed that only Lin Chen was able to leave such a terrifying sword intent on the scene.
"Captain Yuan, what's wrong?"
Pan Wei came over quickly. This was the first time he saw Yuan Chang's face look so ugly.
"City Master Pan, let's all take action immediately. Everyone is flying in different directions, constantly using spiritual power. Call Lin Chen's name as loud as possible. Once we find a battle in the mountains and forests below, we will release the flare immediately."
There was no time to think about it. Yuan Chang knew Lin Chen's strength very well. There were so many towering trees at the scene that were pierced by sword energy, but there seemed to be no unnecessary traces of battle. It was most likely that the enemy Lin Chen faced was very strong, and the opponent's strength far exceeded Lin Chen.
"Action!"
Yuan Chang didn't give anyone any room to answer. The spiritual power in his body surged. He took the lead in flying in the air and began to shout "Lin Chen" loudly.
…
Boom!
Lin Chen kept running away in front of him. After about half an hour, Cai Mian suddenly rushed up behind him, and his hands suddenly gathered together, forming countless waves of spiritual power.
Violent palm prints filled the air, and the spiritual power of heaven and earth gathered together and struck hard at Lin Chen.
Uh-huh!
Lin Chen's eyes were filled with a cold light, and the Blood Night Sword in his hand slashed out fiercely, carrying a strong sword energy, and the Thirteen Wugou Swords were used to the extreme.
However, the sword light collided with the palm print, as if cutting on a ball of cotton.
"Boy, don't struggle in vain. Just surrender and capture me. Maybe I can spare your life." Cai Mian stared at Lin Chen dozens of meters away, feeling secretly shocked.
He really couldn't understand that a young boy at the third level of Nascent Soul Realm, with endless tricks, was chasing him all the way just now.
If his cultivation hadn't been strong enough and his comprehension of the artistic conception of wind was far faster than other peak warriors at the sixth level of the True Martial Realm, he might have really escaped from this kid.
Bang!
The sword light tore apart, and the palm mark hit Lin Chen's chest hard. A mouthful of blood spurted out and flew backwards for more than ten meters.
"Big brother! Use the Taiyuan Temple to smash him to death!"
In the sea of soul consciousness, Ling'er's face was slightly condensed, his eyes flashed nervously, his hands were clenched into fists, and a powerful aura burst out from his body, and he stood on the edge of the eaves of Taiyuan Temple.
"This guy is very strong, and he is also very vigilant. He almost doesn't get close to me. It's too difficult to kill him like this." Lin Chen slowly shook his head.
He had used Taiyuan Temple once before, and he was very aware of the horror of that thing, which almost drained all the spiritual energy from his body.
In his current state, once he uses the Taiyuan Temple to kill the opponent, he may not even be able to use his soul power.
"With such powerful energy and blood, if I can capture him alive and slowly devour his energy and blood bit by bit, it will most likely help me break through to the seventh level of the True Martial Realm."
Cai Mian's eyes were fixed on Lin Chen who was lying on the ground, and his heart was filled with excitement.
Although he was very wary of Lin Chen's identity, he was afraid that the soul power of the Feng family ancestor was hidden in him.
However, this was also the reason why he had been chasing Lin Chen for so long but still did not kill him. If there was a backhand hidden in Lin Chen's body, it must have been released.
"It's not impossible if you want me to capture you without mercy."
Lin Chen secretly circulated his spiritual power and leaned against a big tree. Blood flowed from the corner of his mouth, and his voice pretended to be extremely weak.
"Oh? Tell me."
When Cai Mian heard this, a rare emotion appeared on his facesmile.
With his cultivation at the peak of the sixth level of the True Martial Realm, Lin Chen on the opposite side had no chance to escape. This was why he was so calm and composed.
"Tell me who you are first?"
